name: docs_site
archetype: Developer documentation site in ReadTheDocs / Sphinx style
market: Global, software developers using an open-source framework or library
density: Medium density with clear structure. Left sidebar is permanent and comprehensive — all doc sections listed. Main content area is text-heavy with code blocks, note boxes, and API reference tables. Right sidebar has 'On this page' anchor navigation. Search is critical and prominent.
nav_style: Fixed top nav with project name/logo, version selector dropdown, GitHub link, search bar that opens to full-screen search overlay. Below on every page: left sidebar with collapsible doc sections tree. The sidebar is the primary navigation and is 250px wide fixed.
commercial_model: Open source project docs. Sponsor logos in sidebar footer. Cloud/hosted version 'pro' CTA. Commercial support offered. The docs themselves generate enterprise leads.
color_palette: ReadTheDocs blue (#2980B9) for links and active sidebar items. White (#FFFFFF) main content background. Light blue-grey (#EEF2F6) sidebar background. Dark text (#2C3E50) for body copy. Code blocks in dark background (#2E3440) with syntax highlighting (keywords in blue, strings in green, numbers in orange). Green (#27AE60) for note boxes, yellow for warnings, red for danger.
typography: Lato or Source Sans Pro for prose — clean and readable for long-form reading. Source Code Pro or JetBrains Mono for all code samples. 16px body text with 1.65 line-height for reading comfort. Headings create clear H1-H4 hierarchy with visible nesting in sidebar.

pages.title: Documentation Home
pages.description: Getting started overview. Installation instructions with pip/npm/cargo tabs. Quick start code example. Links to major documentation sections. Features overview table. Community links.

pages.title: Installation Guide
pages.description: Detailed installation instructions for each OS. Prerequisites section. Package manager commands in copy-able code blocks. Virtual environment setup. Verification step with expected output. Troubleshooting note boxes.

pages.title: Quick Start Tutorial
pages.description: Step-by-step first project tutorial. Numbered steps with code blocks after each. Expected output shown. Note boxes explaining concepts. 'Next steps' section at the bottom pointing to more advanced topics.

pages.title: API Reference
pages.description: Complete API reference. Function/class signatures with parameter types. Parameter tables with name, type, required, description columns. Return value specification. Code examples for each method. Deprecated notices.

pages.title: Configuration
pages.description: Configuration options reference. Options table with key, type, default, description. Example configuration files in code blocks. Environment variable alternatives. Advanced configuration patterns section.
